en: Vintage monochrome postcard with light tinting showing a stone tower with a tall conical roof in a tree‑lined square, people walking in the foreground, and another fortified tower and castle-like complex in the background against a mountainous landscape. The word "Trento" is printed at the top in red, and "Torre verde e Castello" at the lower right. A vertical publisher credit appears along the left edge.
